test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The first step to practice waste management is segregation. Select the INCORRECT option with regard to segregation of waste into different categories.

options.text: It helps to identify materials that can be sold to earn revenue
It prevents items suitable for recycling from being thrown away
It increases the amount of waste going into landfills
Segregation helps to reduce the money spent on disposal of waste

solution:
The correct answer is __**It increases the amount of waste going into landfills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Landfills are places designated for the disposal of trash, garbage, and other types of solid waste.
 
• Historically, they have been the most often used technique of removing solid waste, which is either buried or allowed to accumulate in heaps.
 
• Due in major part to the increasing amount of waste generated by our homes, businesses, markets, and hospitals, landfills are a common occurrence around the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some of the landfills included in integrated waste management are well-managed and built.
 
• But the majority of towns neglect their landfills, causing land degradation and an unchecked buildup of various kinds of solid waste.
 
• Here are the causes, effects, and remedies of landfills.
